title: Add explicit CLI editing for Git and worktree metadata
description: Add --git-repo, --git-branch, --worktree-name, and --worktree-dir to task create, task update, and task edit. Preserve existing metadata on update/edit unless a flag is supplied, allow empty values to clear fields, wire the same options through legacy --create-task rewriting, and include metadata in human-readable task output and command help. This task covers explicit CLI input/output only; automatic context defaults are handled separately.

comments.message: Wired create/update/edit metadata flags, legacy create rewriting, task rendering, help, and CLI tests. Running verification now.
